hero-subtext: A warm, play-based daycare in the heart of Langley. We're here when you need us — and we'll love your kiddo like our own.
about-story: In 2014, after struggling to find a daycare that felt warm enough for their own children, the Soo family opened Sunnyside's doors to their neighbourhood.
team-1-bio: ECE Level 3 · 12 years experience. Runs The Treehouse with warmth and a serious love of forest school days.
team-2-bio: ECE Level 2 · 7 years experience. Oversees The Cubby and knows every baby's sleep cues, feed schedule, and favourite song.
team-3-bio: ECE Level 2 · 5 years experience. Leads The Sunbeam Room and has the best voice in the building for storytime.
cubby-lede: Slow days, lots of cuddles, sleep when you sleep. The Cubby moves at your baby's pace — we follow your routine, your bottles, your naps.
treehouse-lede: Curious minds, ready for kindergarten. Project days, big questions, and a lot of new friends — we focus on confidence, kindness, and curiosity before flashcards.
sunbeam-lede: Little explorers learning big feelings. Pretend play, messy hands, and a thousand discoveries before lunch — with the patience and rhythm toddlers need.
